description: Read a base revision, a lane worktree's current register file, and current master to predict the three-way merge of quality_gates/gate_smokes.txt or another named append-only tracked-debt register. Reports master drift, the lane's appended hunk, registrations already duplicated on master, registrations absent from master, and the exact git merge-file -p candidate content with a clean/conflict verdict. It reads Git only; it never stages, commits, merges, creates branches, or changes any Git state.
embedding_description: Predict whether a lane's gate_smokes or tracked-debt register addition merges cleanly with current master. Return the exact candidate content, append-only hunk, duplicate and missing registrations, and clean/conflict result without running a Git merge or mutating a worktree.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Object with refs, drift/append-only flags, lane hunk/registrations, duplicate and missing registrations, merged_candidate_content, merge_verdict, and git_merge_file_exit_code.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with merge_verdict and master_drifted_since_base. On conflict, surface the candidate conflict markers. On clean, name duplicate registrations already present on master and registrations still missing there.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: This is a report-only prediction. Git-Controller decides whether and how to stage or merge.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read-only git show and git merge-file -p against a declared lane worktree and register.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValueError means an absolute root, revision, or confined register path was invalid, the register was absent, or the read-only Git command could not resolve a declared revision/path. A merge conflict is a normal result with merge_verdict=conflict.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Provide an existing lane root, valid non-option revisions, and a tracked repo-relative register path. Resolve an actual conflict in the lane content and rerun; do not treat a clean prediction as authorization to mutate Git.
